title: Không, cảm ơn

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Không, cảm ơn answers the traveler question "No, thank you" in small service and first-contact moments. This helps you decline offers from vendors or service staff politely. Short refusal plus thanks is safer than just saying no. Its job is stating the limit before the order or interaction moves too far. Expect a confirmation, a substitute, or a question about what is allowed; then use Explore next if the reply creates another small task.
